summary: fractal-web displays the selected conversation with the UI kit transcript and sync line. The visible pane holds its conversation follow interest.

compatibility.detail: No server protocol change. The pane is read-only and shows unavailable, waiting, stale, failed, empty, and older-history states.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Route navigation follows the selected conversation and releases the previous interest.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
